name: scheduler
description: Scheduler — the book of jobs (ES modules). Admits ONE job at a time, records what each asked for, and runs it through a RUNNER seam. The runner shipping today is a DUMMY: it executes nothing and says so, so the wiring (submit · queue · run · status) is real and a real runner replaces one file, not one route.
